---
title: Template Catalog
description: All available trusted dev container templates.
---

import TemplateCard from '../../../components/TemplateCard.astro';
import templates from '../../../data/templates.json';

Every template shares a common foundation:

- **Fedora 43 base image** pinned by SHA256 digest
- **Non-root `dev` user** (UID 1001 / GID 1001)
- **uv** pre-installed for feature bootstrap
- **Common tooling**: git, git-lfs, grype, syft, jq, yq

## Templates

| Template | Category | Primary Features |
|---|---|---|
| [Ansible + CUE](/trusted-devcontainer-templates/templates/ansible-cue/) | Infrastructure | ansible-core, python, cuelang |
| [tmux + Neovim + Ansible + CUE](/trusted-devcontainer-templates/templates/neovim-ansible-cue/) | Infrastructure | ansible-core, python, cuelang, tmux, neovim, lazyvim, ansible-tools, sshd |
| [.NET + Node.js](/trusted-devcontainer-templates/templates/dotnet-node/) | Web | dotnet, nodejs, npm, pnpm |
| [Go + CUE](/trusted-devcontainer-templates/templates/go-cue/) | Systems | golang, cuelang |
| [tmux + Neovim + Go](/trusted-devcontainer-templates/templates/neovim-go/) | Systems | golang, tmux, neovim, lazyvim, go-tools, sshd |
| [Java](/trusted-devcontainer-templates/templates/java/) | Enterprise | openjdk, maven, gradle |
| [tmux + Neovim + Java](/trusted-devcontainer-templates/templates/neovim-java/) | Enterprise | openjdk, maven, gradle, tmux, neovim, lazyvim, java-tools, sshd |
| [Python](/trusted-devcontainer-templates/templates/python/) | Data Science | python, uv-ruff |
| [tmux + Neovim + Python](/trusted-devcontainer-templates/templates/neovim-python/) | Data Science | python, uv-ruff, tmux, neovim, lazyvim, python-tools, sshd |

<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 1em; margin-top: 1.5em;">

		<TemplateCard
			id={t.id}
